newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway says oil, gas reserves worth NOK 2,000 bln.
newsitem.headline: Norway says oil, gas reserves worth NOK 2,000 bln.

text.p: The present net value of the cash flow from petroleum resources on the Norwegian continental shelf is 1,925 billion 1997-crowns based on calculations including an international agreement for curbing emissions of carbon dioxide (CO2), the government said on Friday.
Excluding a CO2 agreement, the present net value of petroleum resources would amount to 2,060 billion crowns, the government said in its new Long Term Programme 1998-2001.
The values are based on a real discount rate of four percent.
The state's share of income from the oil industry in both cases would amount to 1,690 and 1,810 billion crowns respectively, it said.
